steps.check: each step defines one residual thing
steps.expr: reg N+1 : within the totality, define one more of the residual (undefined-existent)
steps.what: registration 2+ subdivides the residual of all-that-is
steps.why: both true at once: the division is OF the totality (all-that-is is the ever-present context) AND lands its minimal cut at the residual's edge (what is not yet defined). The residual is selected positively as 'undefined', not as 'not the state'.

steps.expr: each step has a defined thing AND an undefined thing -> isDistinction
steps.what: each registration is a container-00 distinction (rests on 00)
steps.why: every registration, being a defined part with a residual left, is exactly a container-00 distinction: both poles witnessed, both existent. THE DEPENDENCY on 00, computed.

steps.expr: residual_{N+1} subset of residual_N subset of ... subset of all-that-is
steps.what: the residual nests: each is inside the previous
steps.why: the extents are monotone -- what is defined stays defined, so the undefined residual only ever shrinks and never re-covers a defined thing. This is the positive, live form of non-overlap: the state and residual are disjoint by their labels, at every step.

steps.expr: identity(reg) := its live juxtaposition to its ADJACENT registrations
steps.what: co-definition is by adjacency -- live, stepwise (the inject)
steps.why: a registration is not defined by all others but by its adjacency; the definition is forever live -- change one and its adjacent relativities change, and that change propagates STEPWISE through the web. This is exactly why 'inject' spreads one ring at a time. The count of adjacencies is where 12 and the icosahedron will come from (owed, step 1.6).

steps.expr: identity read off the live web of adjacent co-definitions; equal web => equal identity
steps.what: relational identity: a registration IS its live adjacency, nothing stored
steps.why: identity is not independent data: a registration is its live juxtaposition to its adjacent registrations, forever co-defining. Two identities with the same live web are the same. The triad carries up -- every registration is registered by three observers (container 00).
